title: Drive-in double features
blurb: Monsters, mad science and one Santa Claus, from the years when a film had to be scary enough for the back row and short enough for two showings a night. None of these is good in the usual sense. All of them are a good night.

films.note: The one that invented the modern zombie, on a budget of a hundred thousand dollars.
Vincent Price offers five strangers ten thousand dollars to survive a night.
A woman walks away from a car crash and nothing is right afterwards.
Shot in two days. A young Jack Nicholson enjoys the dentist.
Dogs in shag carpets. The film knows.
A cosmetics executive tries an anti-ageing serum made from wasps.
Roger Corman's gangster-comedy-monster film. The creature has ping-pong-ball eyes.
A scientist restores a burned singer's face. It doesn't stay restored.
The aliens' pet is a lobster shadow. The hero is called Derek.
Martians kidnap Santa. A Christmas film, technically.
Messiah of Evil, uploaded as 'Dead People': a seaside town where the dead eat raw meat in the supermarket.
